# Hifdh Helper

> Hifdh Helper (https://hifdh-helper.ummahapps.ai/) is a free web app for memorising the Quran (hifz or hifdh). You enter what you already know and your goal, and it works out what to do on each study day: new hifz, new revision and older revision, with the exact surahs, pages and lines in the 604-page Madinah mushaf. No account is needed; data stays in the browser on the user's device. Made by UmmahApps (https://ummahapps.ai/).

## What it does

- New hifz: spreads the remaining pages over the chosen study days, to reach either a finish date or a set amount each week, counted in pages or lines (15 lines to a page), from a chosen start date. Part pages are shown to the line, for example "p.61 lines 1–8".
- Weekly new hifz: each week has a set amount, so doing extra one day makes the following days lighter, and doing less adds a little to them. The day the week starts on can be chosen.
- New revision: spaced repetition. By default each day of new hifz is revised every study day for 21 days, then comes back 3, 7, 14 and 30 days after that, before joining the older cycle. Missed reviews carry over. Alternatively, revise the last few days of new hifz every day.
- Revision: everything older is revised in a full cycle, every 30 days by default. Each day's list starts from the first pages not yet revised in the current cycle, so pages revised early are not asked for again and skipped pages come up first. The daily target stays the same.
- Revision progress: see which surahs are revised in the current cycle, juz by juz, and tap any surah not yet done to mark it revised, or enter page numbers. Each page is counted once.
- Hard pages: a page marked hard, chosen from any memorised page, comes back the next day, 3 days later and 7 days later, on top of normal revision.
- Sick, travelling or on a period: set in Settings. Sick pauses everything (anything done can still be added) and pauses hard page reviews. Travelling pauses new hifz only. On a period, revision, reading and new hifz can each be kept as normal, stopped, or increased by a chosen amount a day. New hifz can also be paused on its own.
- Daily reading tick with a streak, for reading pages not yet memorised.
- Plan view: juz-by-juz progress, current pace, projected finish date, and how daily revision grows as more is memorised.
- Several people on one device, for a family or a class, each with their own goal, schedule and colour theme.
- Memorise forward (towards An-Nas) or backwards surah by surah towards Al-Fatihah (for example starting with Juz Amma), learning each surah from its first page and skipping pages already known.

## Good to know

- Free to use, works in any modern browser on phone, tablet or computer, and can be added to the home screen.
- Uses the Madinah mushaf: 604 pages, 30 juz of about 20 pages each.
